evidence: Prospective protocol fixed before acoustic feature extraction
reserved: EN04: original EN02 song, annotated lines 4–6
EN05: original EN03 song, annotated lines 4–6
limitations: Reserved passages and new mutations, not new singers. Existing annotation-defined short excerpts; no full-song or pretraining independence. Japanese phone-to-source phrase localization unavailable.

candidate_features.spectral: 40-ms Hann windows, 10-ms hop; spectral flatness <0.3 and RMS above local-clip p90 minus 30 dB. Harmonic/energy proxy, not vocals.
candidate_features.ctc_activity: Audio-only argmax nonspecial/nonseparator frames, 20-ms grid. No forced text path. English speech model; Japanese activity transfer unqualified.
candidate_features.lexical: English only: normalized Levenshtein disagreement between audio-only greedy letters and supplied canonical letters, divided by maximum length. No language model or replacement transcript.

coverage: For each activity proxy, fraction of active frames outside the union of estimated lines plus fraction of estimated line frames without activity; use maximum. No registration or endpoint repair.
fit: Each feature separately: threshold above highest matched development score and midway to lowest higher negative; inseparable negatives remain missed. Old thresholds unchanged. Freeze before scoring reserved controls. No post-holdout feature or threshold changes.
combination: OR of existing score/unresolved flag and individual independent flag; no learned ensemble.
localization: Compare activity intervals with independent annotated word intervals (English) or nonpause phones (Japanese); duration precision/recall and gap false activity. Lexical disagreement makes no localization claim.
promotion: Review-only at most; no automatic acceptance. Report all failures and false rejection; small sample intervals descriptive only.
resources: No new downloads; existing isolated environment, cumulative 2 GB download / 6 GB storage limits.
